headline: Make room for one good idea.
subhead: A quieter place to plan what matters.
status: Original sample campaign · fictional product · not launched

brief.objective: Introduce Morrow Focus Notebook and invite people to explore its product page during a seven-day concept launch.
brief.product: An A5 linen-cover notebook with dot-grid pages, a lay-flat binding, and a ribbon marker. These are supplied fictional product specifications, not verified claims.
brief.audience: Independent designers and knowledge workers who want a paper space for early ideas and daily priorities.
brief.offer: Explore the notebook. No launch discount, price, or delivery promise is invented.
brief.constraint: Do not claim improved productivity, environmental certification, or customer preference without supporting evidence.

research.signal: A5 format, dot-grid paper, lay-flat binding
research.decision: Show the page and binding; use concrete product language.

research.signal: Audience values a quiet space away from screens
research.decision: Test the focus-led message against a utility-led alternative.

research.signal: Interest could differ between designers and other knowledge workers
research.decision: Keep audience cohorts separate in the measurement sheet.

positioning: For people whose work starts with an idea, Morrow is a considered paper space for thinking before the next tab opens.

messagePillars.title: Space to think
messagePillars.copy: Lead with a single idea and generous negative space. Avoid productivity promises.

messagePillars.title: Details that support the ritual
messagePillars.copy: Show the dot grid, lay-flat page, and linen texture from the supplied brief.

messagePillars.title: A gentle next step
messagePillars.copy: Invite a product-page visit. Do not manufacture urgency or social proof.

copy.primary: Before the tabs. Before the notifications. One page for the idea you want to keep. Meet Morrow Focus Notebook: dot-grid pages, a lay-flat binding, and room to begin.
copy.variant: Your next idea starts on a blank page. Explore the A5 Morrow Focus Notebook, made around a simple writing ritual.
copy.social: Some ideas need a little space. Start with a page, a pencil, and the thought you keep coming back to. Meet Morrow Focus Notebook. #MorrowNotebook #MakeRoomForIdeas
copy.emailSubject: A quieter place for your next idea
copy.emailBody:
Hello,

Not every idea needs another tab. Sometimes it needs a page.

Morrow Focus Notebook pairs a linen cover with dot-grid pages and a lay-flat binding, giving your notes, sketches, and daily priorities a place of their own.

Take a closer look at the notebook and find your next starting point.

Meet your next page
The Morrow team

measurement.decision: Compare headline A and B within the same audience and placement.

measurement.definition: Sessions with product_detail_view / campaign landing sessions × 100
measurement.decision: Check whether visitors explore the product, not just the headline.

measurement.definition: Sessions with product_interest / campaign landing sessions × 100
measurement.decision: Use an explicit product-interest action; do not treat a page view as purchase intent.

analysisRule: Keep spend, placement, and audience consistent between variants. Review delivery and tracking first. Do not declare a winner from a small or uneven sample; agree on a minimum sample and decision rule before launch.
review: Confirm product specifications, naming rights, price, stock, and destination URL with the product owner.
Replace the concept product image with an approved production photograph before a real launch.
Approve the copy, usage rights, tracking consent, and opt-in email audience.
Configure a real landing page and event tracking; QA links and UTM values.
Approve channel budgets and measurement thresholds. No campaign has been published or measured.
